styles.name: galloping-horse
styles.description: Chestnut horse in side profile galloping right — ears, muzzle, flying tail, legs cycling stretch-gather and kicking up dust

styles.name: butterfly
styles.description: Monarch butterfly with big upper and lower wings flapping open and shut as it flutters right over a dotted flight path

styles.name: spider-web
styles.description: Eight-legged spider spinning a silver orb web — it lays the spokes first, then walks the rings round as progress fills

styles.name: beehive
styles.description: Hexagonal honeycomb filling with amber honey cell by cell while two striped bees buzz loops around the front

styles.name: peacock-fan
styles.description: Blue peacock with a crested head raising its train — eye-spotted feathers fan wider and fuller as progress grows

styles.name: leaping-frog
styles.description: Bug-eyed frog croaking on a lily pad, then leaping pad to pad across the pond with legs outstretched

styles.name: octopus
styles.description: Domed octopus with two eyes and six curling tentacles waving below as it jets right, bubbles trailing

styles.name: owl
styles.description: Tufted owl with big ringed amber eyes and a beak, sidling along a branch and blinking

styles.name: murmuration
styles.description: Starling murmuration — a dense, shape-shifting cloud of birds that swells, twists and pinches as it sweeps right

styles.name: elephant
styles.description: Grey elephant plodding right — domed back, flapping ear, ivory tusk, swinging trunk and four pillar legs

styles.name: bat-swoop
styles.description: Big-eared bat beating its scalloped wings as it swoops right past a full moon under twinkling stars
